title: Check: Reactions of Acids with Metal Oxides (B)

questions.stem: What colour change is observed when black copper oxide reacts with dilute sulfuric acid?
questions.explanation: When black copper oxide dissolves in sulfuric acid, it forms copper sulfate solution, which is blue. The black solid disappears as it dissolves, and the colourless acid gradually turns blue. CuO + H₂SO₄ → CuSO₄ + H₂O.
